list.label: Urgency pressure
list.description: Pushes the reader to act before thinking (deadlines, 'immediately', 'last chance').

list.label: Threat or consequence
list.description: Warns of loss, blocking, penalties or legal action if the reader does not comply.

list.label: Authority / brand impersonation
list.description: Claims to be a bank, regulator, government body, police or well-known company AND asks the reader to act.

list.label: Financial reward promise
list.description: Promises prizes, winnings, cashback or gifts the reader did not ask for.

list.label: Request for sensitive information
list.description: Asks the reader to reveal or enter OTPs, PINs, passwords, card or identity details.

list.label: Suspicious payment request
list.description: Asks for money up-front: fees, deposits, 'processing charges', UPI collect / QR approvals.

list.label: Pushes an external link
list.description: Directs the reader to click, tap or open a link or download an app.

list.label: Fake job / investment lure
list.description: Offers easy income, part-time tasks, guaranteed returns or trading tips.

list.label: Emotional manipulation
list.description: Uses fear, sympathy, family emergencies or romance to lower the reader's guard.

list.label: Secrecy or isolation
list.description: Asks the reader to keep the matter secret or not to consult the bank, family or police.

safety_advice.description: Contains standard safety advice (do not share / we never ask)

transaction_alert.description: Looks like a bank / wallet transaction alert

delivery_update.description: Looks like an order / delivery status update

reminder.description: Looks like an appointment / bill / class reminder

TACTIC_PHRASES.threat: threatens consequences such as blocking, penalties or legal action
TACTIC_PHRASES.authority: invokes a bank, brand or authority while asking you to act
TACTIC_PHRASES.reward: promises an unexpected prize or reward
TACTIC_PHRASES.sensitive_info: asks for sensitive details such as an OTP, PIN or card number
TACTIC_PHRASES.payment: asks for an up-front payment or fee
TACTIC_PHRASES.link: pushes you to open a link or install an app
TACTIC_PHRASES.job_investment: offers easy income or guaranteed returns
TACTIC_PHRASES.emotional: uses emotional pressure (emergency, family or romance)
TACTIC_PHRASES.secrecy: asks you to keep the matter secret

SIGNAL_PHRASES.brand_domain_mismatch: links to a domain that does not belong to the brand it names
SIGNAL_PHRASES.shortened_link: hides its destination behind a shortened link
SIGNAL_PHRASES.ip_link: links to a raw IP address
SIGNAL_PHRASES.at_in_url: contains a deceptive '@' inside a link
SIGNAL_PHRASES.obfuscation: uses disguised characters that can evade filters
SIGNAL_PHRASES.messaging_app: moves the conversation to WhatsApp or Telegram
SIGNAL_PHRASES.defanged_link: writes its link in a disguised format

FEATURE_LABELS.sem_logit: Language of the message (semantic text model)
FEATURE_LABELS.call_request: Asks you to call a number

MUTATION_TYPES.char_substitution: Swap letters for look-alike digits (acc0unt, v3rify)
MUTATION_TYPES.spacing: Space out key words (K Y C, v e r i f y)
MUTATION_TYPES.unicode_confusables: Replace Latin letters with Cyrillic look-alikes
MUTATION_TYPES.hinglish: Rewrite common phrases in Romanised Hindi
MUTATION_TYPES.url_variation: Reformat links (defanged hxxp, [.] dots, no scheme)
MUTATION_TYPES.combined: Character substitution + spacing + mixed case together
